title: Groveworks
body:
🌿 Groveworks 🌿
Nature thrives. Machines whir. Monsters wake.

Groveworks is a 1.20.1 Fabric modpack that throws you into a vibrant world where serene groves meet mechanical genius and dangerous magic. Build sprawling factories with Create, battle deadly bosses from Mowzie’s Mobs, and roam the world catching your favorite Cobblemon.

⚙️ Create for all your steampunky automation dreams
🦎 Cobblemon to explore, train, and battle with your favorite creatures
🦴 Mowzie’s Mobs to keep you on your toes (and maybe screaming)
🌿 A perfect balance of chill building and intense encounters
🔥 No quests, no rails your story is your own

Whether you’re crafting cozy cottages or getting yeeted by a raging plant god, Groveworks is here for the modded chaos gremlin inside you.
